name: inline-image
description: Draws images inline in Claude Code replies: write ![alt](/path/to/image) and the picture appears under the text. Any format ImageMagick reads.

maxColumns.title: Max width (columns)
maxColumns.description: Widest an image may be, in terminal columns. It is also limited by the pane width.

maxRows.title: Max height (rows)
maxRows.description: Tallest an image may be, in terminal rows.

maxImages.title: Max images per message
maxImages.description: Extra images in one message are left as plain text.

cellAspect.title: Cell aspect (height / width)
cellAspect.description: How much taller a terminal cell is than wide. 2.0 to 2.2 is typical; it only affects how tall an image is drawn.

cellWidthPx.title: Cell width in pixels (optional)
cellWidthPx.description: Only needed if hairlines show between the rows of an image. With the cell height, each image is scaled to the exact pixel size of its box. 0 = detect it from the terminal when it reports it, otherwise off. To measure: screenshot width in pixels divided by the number of columns.

cellHeightPx.title: Cell height in pixels (optional)
cellHeightPx.description: See cell width. Screenshot height of one text row in pixels. 0 = detect / off.

allowRemote.title: Allow http(s) images
allowRemote.description: Download and show images given as web URLs. Off by default: a reply could otherwise make your machine fetch any URL.
